auditType: Independent read-only acceptance-criteria reconciliation; no new execution
method: Read the exact acceptance-criteria text and contemporaneous verification notes captured in the input, then followed retained regression/native reports and later tracker acceptance links.
Status and checked flags are not treated as evidence. Intermediate failures and missing ephemeral paths are not silently converted to passes.
A criterion may be supported by meaningful regressions plus relevant native acceptance without requiring every negative/race case in a browser, unless its own wording requires that boundary.
No tests, browser, inference, runtime, native DB, credentials, source/task/tracker/git edits were performed for this audit. Only this private audit artifact and its reproducible builder were written.
